title: Grade 3
blurb: Unit-by-unit practice for the whole Grade 3 year — numbers to 1000, the four operations, first fractions, shapes, measuring and data, with a separate problem set for every unit.

units.title: Numbers to 1000
units.blurb: Hundreds, tens and ones, words and digits, comparing and ordering, step counting and rounding to the nearest ten.

units.title: Addition & Subtraction to 1000
units.blurb: Mental tens and hundreds, column addition with a carry, column subtraction with a break, fact families and word problems.

units.title: Multiplication — First Facts
units.blurb: Equal groups, arrays and the turnaround, the tables of 2, 5 and 10, the threes and fours, and times one and times zero.

units.title: Division — Sharing & Grouping
units.blurb: Sharing into equal parts, grouping into bundles, division facts from the tables, dividing by 3 and 4, and choosing the operation.

units.title: Fractions — Halves, Thirds & Quarters
units.blurb: Naming equal parts, how many make a whole, comparing unit fractions, the leftover part, and a fraction of a set.

units.title: Shapes, Sides & Corners
units.blurb: Naming flat shapes by their sides, square corners, solid shapes and what they do, shape patterns and sorting.

units.title: Measuring, Time & Money
units.blurb: Reading a ruler, metres and centimetres, comparing mass and capacity, o'clock and half past, and counting tögrög.

units.title: Tallies & Picture Graphs
units.blurb: Reading and drawing tallies, table totals and missing rows, one-for-one picture graphs and the questions they answer.

forms.title: What a digit is worth
forms.skill: A digit's value is the digit times its place — read the column, not the digit.

forms.title: Choosing the operation

variants.statement: $6$ pencils are packed $3$ to a box. Which operation finds the number of boxes?

forms.title: Telling the time
forms.skill: Long hand for minutes, short hand for the hour it has PASSED.

variants.statement: The long hand points straight up and the short hand points at the $1$. What time is it?
variants.explanation: The long hand straight up is zero minutes past, so the hour has just begun — and the short hand names it: one o'clock.

variants.statement: The long hand points straight down and the short hand sits between the $1$ and the $2$. What time is it?
variants.explanation: The long hand straight down means $30$ of the hour's $60$ minutes have gone. The hour is the one the short hand has PASSED, so it is half past one.

forms.title: Working out change
forms.skill: Payment minus price, then check by adding the change back.

variants.statement: An item costs $60$ tögrög and you pay with $200$. What is the change?
variants.explanation: Change is payment minus price: $200 - 60 = 140$ tögrög. Receipt: $140 + 60 = 200$, which returns exactly what was handed over.
